description: Using 13 years of observations, NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory produced its sharpest-ever view of the jet from M87's supermassive black hole. The data reveal new structures, cooling particles, and magnetic fields that help scientists understand how black holes shape galaxies.
title: Chandra Captures Sharpest-Ever X-Ray View of M87 Black Hole Jet

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders will begin on June 25, Rockstar Games has announced. The studio also revealed the cover art for the game. GTA 6 will be available to pre-order on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. The game is set to launch on November 19, 2026.
title: Rockstar Games Confirms GTA 6 Pre-Orders Will Begin June 25, Reveals New Cover Art

description: Honor 600 Smart 5G will launch in France soon with a 6.87-inch display and a 7,700mAh battery. Ahead of the official launch, the phone has been prematurely listed by a retailer, revealing price details, colour options and key specifications. The Honor 600 Smart 5G is listed in two finishes with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 processor. It is likely to pack 4GB of RAM and 128GB of storage.
title: Honor 600 Smart 5G With 7,700mAh Battery Listed on French Website, Could Launch Soon: Price, Features

description: Aztec has suffered a second security breach in under a week, with attackers exploiting a legacy bridge linked to its private rollup infrastructure and stealing more than $2.1 million in crypto assets. Aztec Labs said the attack affected an immutable smart contract tied to a discontinued product launched in 2022 and was unrelated to the earlier exploit. The incident has renewed concerns about the risks posed by deprecated smart contracts that continue to hold user funds.
title: Aztec Hit With Second Security Breach, Days After Hackers Used Exploit to Steal $2.19 Million

description: Oppo has teased the arrival of the Enco Air 5 true wireless earbuds in India through a dedicated Amazon microsite. The listing confirms the earbuds will support noise cancellation and offers an early look at their design, including an in-ear form factor and a rounded charging case. Oppo has not yet revealed specifications, pricing, or launch details. The development follows the launch of the Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro in India in May, which offers up to 54 hours of battery life.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5 India Launch Teased; Amazon Availability Confirmed

description: Huawei FreeBuds 7i and FreeBuds SE 4 ANC were launched in India as the truly wireless earphones from Huawei. They offer Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity and are IP54-rated for dust and splash resistance. The new Huawei FreeBuds 7i earphones have 11mm dynamic drivers, and the FreeBuds SE 4 ANC feature a 10mm dynamic driver unit. They offer an active noise cancellation (ANC) feature.
title: Huawei FreeBuds 7i, FreeBuds SE 4 ANC Launched in India With Up to 50 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: The McBee Dynasty Season 3 is an American docuseries that is now available to stream only on JioHotstar.
title: The McBee Dynasty Season 3 Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Reality Docuseries Online

description: Mermaid follows a troubled man whose life changes after rescuing an injured mermaid and protecting her from a hostile world.
title: Mermaid OTT Release: Where to Watch the Johnny Pemberton Fantasy Drama Online

description: Murder 101 follows students and their teacher as they investigate real-life cold cases in a gripping three-part true crime docuseries.
title: Murder 101 OTT Release: When and Where to Watch the True Crime Docuseries

description: Poco is rumoured to be expanding its C-series smartphone lineup. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to reveal any details, an unannounced Poco handset has been sighted on a certification platform. While the listing does not reveal the official moniker of the phone, previous database entries suggest it could arrive as the Poco C95 Pro 4G. Alongside its model number, the certification also sheds light on some of the purported handset’s connectivity features.
title: Poco C95 Pro 4G Picks Up Singapore’s IMDA Certification; Could Arrive With Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 Chip

description: Vivo Y6e 5G has been launched in China. The budget smartphone is currently on sale in China in a single 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The phone is offered in Flowing Clouds White, Sunset Blue, and Twilight Black (translated from Chinese) colour options. The smartphone is equipped with a 6.74-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen with up to 120Hz refresh rate and up to 1,200 nits peak brightness. Vivo’s new Y series smartphone is powered by a 4nm octa core Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset from Qualcomm.
title: Vivo Y6e 5G Launched With 6,500mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Tether has announced that it will discontinue Alloy by Tether and its gold-collateralised aUSDT stablecoin after two years of operation. The company said the decision follows a review of user activity, market demand, and broader strategic priorities. Existing users will have three months to redeem their aUSDT holdings and reclaim the underlying XAUT collateral, while Tether shifts its focus toward products with stronger liquidity, greater adoption, and larger market opportunities.
title: Tether to Cease Operations of Gold-Linked aUSDT Stablecoin

description: For The Real Me Season 1 is a micro-drama reel series that has been produced by FilterCopy. It is now available to stream on the Instagram page of the same.
title: FilterCopy’s For The Real Me Season 1 Now on Instagram: Know Everything About This Micro-Drama Reel Series

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series will be launched in multiple markets next month, the company has announced. The next-generation lineup is expected to comprise three models — Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, and Reno 16F. Ahead of their anticipated debut, the handsets have been made available for pre-order, while also revealing their colourways and storage configurations. The Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16 Pro, notably, made their China debut on May 25.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Launch Date in Indonesia, Malaysia Announced as Pre-Orders Begin

description: Narwal S20 Pro, S20, and S30 vacuum cleaners have been launched in India. All three models feature a 4,000mAh battery and are claimed to provide up to 60 minutes of runtime on a single charge. The Narwal S30 and S20 Pro feature 20,000Pa suction power, while the S20 offers 18,000Pa suction. They have hot-water self-cleaning technology, anti-tangle engineering and smart cleaning modes.
title: Narwal S20, S20 Pro, S30 Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaners With Up to 20,000Pa Suction Launched in India:Price, Features

description: Amazon announced that the 10th edition of Prime Day in India will take place from July 4 through July 6, 2026. The sale will bring discounts on all product categories, and there will be new launches. This is the 10th edition of Amazon Prime Day, and the company is giving membership discounts. Prime members will get an additional 10 percent instant discount when making purchases using SBI or Axis Bank credit cards and EMI transactions during the sale.
title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Sale Dates Announced, Prime Membership Price Drops to Rs. 999

description: Rockstar Games has announced free Grand Theft Auto V upgrades for PlayStation 4, digital Xbox One, and PC Legacy edition owners. Eligible players can move to the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, or Enhanced PC versions without an additional fee. The company also revealed GTA Online: The Kortz Centre Heist, a new multi-stage mission centred on stealing artwork from a gallery in Pacific Bluffs. The update arrives in July and will be accompanied by bonus rewards, discounts, and other limited-time promotions.
title: GTA 5 Owners to Get Free PS5, Xbox Series X/S Version Upgrades Ahead of New Heist

description: Vivo X Fold 6 is confirmed to come with a 7000mAh 'Blue Ocean' battery, marking a notable upgrade over the Vivo X Fold 5's 6,000mAh cell. It will have an IPX8+IPX9 rated build for dust and water resistance. The new phone will be available in four colour options and will run on a 3nm MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Super Edition chipset.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Battery and Durability Details Teased Days Ahead of June 26 Launch

description: Honor X80 Pro Max will be powered by an octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.6GHz, according to a China Telecom listing. The listing also suggests that the phone will be offered in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, 8GB + 256GB, 8GB + 512GB, and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. The smartphone will be equipped with a 6.8-inch display. It could also boast an 8-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls. Moreover, the handset might ship with Honor’s Android 16-based MagicOS 10. It is shown to measure 162.2×77×8.08mm and weigh about 203g.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Key Specifications, Storage Options Revealed via China Telecom Listing Days Before Launch

description: Treyarch has announced PlayStation ports of Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2. The ports will be released next month, likely on PS4 and PS5 — Treyarch has not specified platforms yet. The ports have been developed by Iron Galaxy. Both ports will feature Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 Are Being Ported to PlayStation Consoles Next Month

description: Apple is reportedly developing a second-generation iPhone Air that could launch in spring 2027. According to a recent report, the handset is undergoing advanced testing under the V62 codename and may feature an ultrawide rear camera alongside improvements to battery life. The report states that Apple sees the camera system and battery performance as major areas for refinement. The company is also said to be revising its iPhone launch strategy, with future models expected to debut at different times of the year rather than together.
title: iPhone Air 2 Said to Be in the Works, Could Launch in 2027 With Camera and Battery Upgrades

description: Anuj Sharma, CMO, Xiaomi India, has stepped down from the role after nearly eight years. Talking to select media earlier this week, Anuj hinted that the decision was made quite some time ago, rather than being a sudden flashpoint. Sharma also joked about how the absolute pressure cooker of the Indian smartphone space over the last eight years has physically aged him.
title: Xiaomi India CMO Anuj Sharma Steps Down After 8 Years

description: Xiaomi India has confirmed it will launch large appliances in the second half of 2026. The senior leadership team at Xiaomi India, while addressing a small section of the media, announced the news. At this point, there's no update on which product will launch first, but hinted that local testing is already on. The company also touched upon localising manufacturing, and this could mean that we may see Made-in-India large appliances with the Xiaomi logo in India before the end of 2026.
title: Xiaomi Wants a Bigger Space in Your Home: Confirms Entry Into the Large Appliances Category in India

description: Nothing has declared itself a rival to established smartphone brands, especially Apple, time and again. In recent years, co-founder and CEO Carl Pei has stated that the company aims to build a compelling ecosystem, one that can rival Apple’s tightly integrated hardware. The executive has once again taken aim at the Cupertino-based tech giant through a video posted on the company’s social media handle, declaring the intention to win over iPhone users.
title: Nothing Founder Carl Pei Says He’s Coming for Apple’s Customers, One iPhone User at a Time

description: Android 17 introduces a new version of Android Switch that enables faster and “more comprehensive” migration to Android from other platforms, including Apple’s iOS, Google’s Product Lead for Android Onboarding and Settings, Paul Dunlop, announced on Wednesday. Now, users will no longer have to download a standalone app, like Switch to Android, to migrate from iOS to Android. The company says that Android Switch is now built directly into both platforms. The tool now lets users migrate over Wi-Fi without losing data. Similarly, the feature now supports the transfer of additional data types, including passwords, passkeys, Wi-Fi credentials, and alarms.
title: Android 17 Offers Upgraded Android Switch Tool With Support for Transferring iMessages, Passkeys, Passwords and Alarms

description: Samsung announced a major update to its Samsung Health app earlier this month. During the announcement, the company promised that the update would begin rolling out on June 8; however, the brand missed this deadline. It now seems to have begun rolling out the major Samsung Health update. The update with version 7.00.0.107 is said to be rolling out globally to devices running One UI 9.0, which is available only on the Galaxy S26 series.
title: Samsung Health Update Starts Rolling Out With Vitals, Heart Health Score and More Improvements

description: JBL has launched the Live 780NC and Live 680NC wireless headphones in India. Both models feature 40mm dynamic drivers, JBL Spatial Sound 3.0, Personi-Fi 3.0, LDAC audio support, Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity, and multipoint pairing. They also offer True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0 and up to 80 hours of battery life with ANC disabled. The JBL Live 780NC is priced at Rs. 15,999, while the JBL Live 680NC costs Rs. 11,999. The headphones are available in seven colour options.
title: JBL Live 780NC, JBL Live 680NC Launched in India With Up to 80-Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: OnePlus N6 has been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number CPH2955. As per the listing, the handset will be powered by an octa core MediaTek MT6835 chipset, which could either be the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 or MediaTek Dimensity 6100+ SoC. The OnePlus N6 is expected to feature six efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz, along with two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.4GHz. The handset is listed with 5.49GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 6GB of RAM. Moreover, the OnePlus N series smartphone is expected to ship with Android 16 in India, which could be based on OnePlus’ OxygenOS 16.
title: OnePlus N6 Runs Geekbench With a MediaTek Dimensity 6 Series Chip, 6GB RAM

description: Epic Games unveiled the features of Unreal Engine 6, the next iteration of its game engine. UE6 will feature Gemini and Claude integration to speed up game development workflows. Epic said it is targeting Early Access release at the end of 2027, with the full release of UE6 coming 12-18 months later.
title: Epic Games Confirms Unreal Engine 6 Comes With Claude, Gemini Integration; Releases UE 5.8 Update

description: Bitcoin slipped below $64,000 on Thursday as investors reacted to the Federal Reserve’s hawkish policy outlook and higher inflation projections. Analysts said continued ETF outflows, weak institutional demand, and expectations of tighter financial conditions have kept risk appetite subdued. While Bitcoin remains above key support levels, traders are closely watching the $67,500-$68,000 resistance zone for signs of stronger momentum and a potential recovery.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $64,000 as Hawkish US Fed Outlook Dampens Market Sentiment

description: Oppo Reno 15A 5G has been launched in Japan as the latest addition to the company’s Reno lineup. The handset is currently available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo online store. It is offered in Afterglow Pink, Aurora Blue, and Twilight Navy (translated from Japanese) colour options. The smartphone is powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. Moreover, it is equipped with a 7,000mAh battery and offers support for 80W wired fast charging.
title: Oppo Reno 15A 5G Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Xiaomi 17T stands courtesy of its Leica-tuned cameras, particularly the exceptional 5x telephoto lens, which delivers an imaging experience that few competitors can match. Despite its shortcomings, it is one of the most well-rounded sub-flagship smartphones available today.  If a great mobile photography experience is on your priority list, the Xiaomi 17T is an easy recommendation.
title: Xiaomi 17T Review: Everything You Need, Nothing You Don't

description: ChatGPT continues to be the world’s most popular artificial intelligence (AI) assistant, but it now faces intense competition in the generative AI space. According to a recent market analysis, the AI chatbot’s market share has slipped below the 50 percent mark for the first time since its launch in late 2022. The report mentions that users are increasingly looking towards rival AI apps like Gemini, Claude, and Grok. The move reportedly indicates a shift in consumer behaviour, with external events affecting user loyalty.
title: ChatGPT’s Market Share Falls Below 50 Percent for First Time as Gemini, Claude Gain Ground: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series, which is expected to include the rumoured Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Samsung’s first wide-folding Galaxy Z Fold 8, will be launched with a higher price tag than last year’s Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7, a tipster claims, citing retailers. The upcoming foldables from the South Korean tech conglomerate are likely to see a price in the European and Asian markets. The tech giant is reportedly raising the launch prices of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 series compared to last year’s Galaxy Z Fold 7 due to “internal and external” factors, including the increase in manufacturing costs.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Series Tipped to Launch at Higher Price Than Last Year’s Galaxy Z Fold 7

description: Honor has teased MagicOS 11 through a series of Weibo videos, offering an early look at its Android 17-based software update. The redesigned interface features transparent layers, reflective surfaces, animated highlights, and other visual effects that closely resemble Apple's Liquid Glass design language. The company has also opened the MagicOS 11 Pioneer Edition Early Access Programme in China. Testing is currently limited to the Honor Magic 8 series, with registrations open until June 18 and wider availability expected later.
title: Honor Teases MagicOS 11 Update With Liquid Glass-Inspired Design as Early Access Programme Kicks Off

description: Google Home Speaker is currently available for pre-orders in select international markets. It is priced at $99.99 (roughly Rs. 8,900) in the US and will start shipping on June 25. It is offered in Berry, Hazel, Jade, and Porcelain colour options. The speaker with Gemini integration was unveiled in October last year. It comes with Gemini for Home voice assistant and has a quad-core A55 processor with 2.0GHz speed. It offers omnidirectional sound through a 58mm full-range driver.
title: Google Home Speaker Finally Makes Its Global Debut, Available to Pre-Order in Select Markets: Price, Features

description: Apple is said to be preparing price hikes across its product portfolio. According to a report, rapidly rising costs of memory and storage chips could pressure the Cupertino-based tech giant to raise prices. In a recent interview, Apple CEO Tim Cook said that price increases may be unavoidable as the company grapples with a global shortage of memory components driven by booming demand from AI data centres. The Apple executive, however, did not reveal which products could become more expensive or when the changes might take effect.
title: Apple May Reportedly Raise iPhone, Mac Prices Amid Memory Chip Shortage, Tim Cook Says
